desc: Derive the exact matching condition and substring-length formula for fragments `A*B*C`, including empty fragments and boundary cases.
Implement linear-time occurrence detection for each fixed fragment using KMP, handling empty fragments as occurring at every boundary.
Design efficient successor queries over occurrence positions to find the earliest `B` after an `A` and earliest `C` after that `B`.
Prove the resulting algorithm’s correctness and analyze its time and space complexity for lengths up to `10^5`.
Integrate the approach into `Solution.shortestMatchingSubstring(self, s: str, p: str)` using the required starter-code format.
